fields.Name: IT138 - Query Extraction Correctness
fields.Description: Saves fixture queries with extraction on (a normal save) over a fixture schema (mjit_extract: two tables and a view over a view, created and dropped by the bundle) and core MJ views, and asserts exactly what extraction wrote, on SQL Server and PostgreSQL. QE1 field rows of a query over tables: order, base and full type per platform, nullability (SQL Server reports it; PostgreSQL's describe does not), computed, and the schema.object source of a column no entity backs. QE2 a query over a view on a view keeps the inner types. QE3 a query over __mj.vwUsers binds each column to its MJ: Users field. QE4 Query Entities lists entities read in a CTE body, a join and an EXISTS subquery, never a CTE name spelled like an entity view. QE5 parameters are required only when a use sits outside every if, typed by their filters, with defaults and doc-comment and trailing --: descriptions on the right rows. QE6 the fields are the union of every branch render, with a note naming the else-branch column. QE7 an external-data-source query is Skipped and gets no fields. QE8 a query whose table is named by a template parameter keeps its declared fields. QE9 two output columns with one name are refused at save. QE10 ExtractionStatus, ExtractedSQLHash and UsesTemplate are recorded. QE11 a composition that leaves out a required parameter of its target is refused at save (MJQ_COMPOSITION_MISSING_ARGUMENT); one that passes it records its dependency by full path with the argument mapping. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Extraction writes exactly the fields, entities and parameters the SQL and the database server establish, on both platforms.
